# datagecko_stream_metric (Resource)

A metric's row on one stream: connects the metric to the stream and carries its per-stream params (coverage's markers and target, as series ids).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "datagecko_stream_metric" "revenue_coverage" {
  stream_id = datagecko_stream.revenue.id
  metric_id = datagecko_metric.coverage.id
  params = jsonencode({
    markers = [datagecko_series.deployed.id]
    target  = datagecko_series.delivery.id
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metric_id` (String)
- `stream_id` (String)

### Optional

- `params` (String) The row's params, exactly as given; replaced whole on change. A JSON object; write it with jsonencode().

### Read-Only

- `effective` (String) The type's defaults, then the metric's params, then this row's.
- `id` (String) <stream_id>/<metric_id>: the import identifier. The pair is the row's identity.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By <stream id>/<metric id>.
terraform import datagecko_stream_metric.revenue_coverage 4f1c6a3e-.../7c0e2b91-...
```
